title: Williams-Brice Stadium
geometryBasis: OpenStreetMap stadium shell, playing-field control and side-deck outlines, calibrated against two exact public-domain Qualla photographs taken on the same 2006 game day.
sectionBasis: The university documents the two main upper decks, end-zone additions and the date of the later north scoreboard. The 2006 photographs provide the major bearing frames, ramp tiers, lighting beams and press box proportions.
limitations: The depiction is dated October 2006. Later renovations, including the 2012 north video board and subsequent concourse upgrades, are outside this configuration.
Mapped plan controls fix the field, main deck spans and site orientation. Deck sectional heights, individual benches, signwork, services and small fixture details use bounded estimates.
